newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - March 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Air force Mi-24 attack helicopter missing off Mullaitivu Tamil Tiger rebel stronghold.
President Chandrika Kumaratunga appeals for peaceful poll on Friday.
Opposition leader Ranil Wickremesinghe says government has broken its promise to hold peaceful poll because it knows people's verdict wil be unfavourable to it.
All political parties pledge their co-operation for a peaceful local government poll on Friday.
Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat to visit Sri Lanka next week.
Pakistani Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif to visit Sri Lanka at President Kumaratunga's invitation.
Defence Ministry orders probe into all crashes of air force planes and helicopters.
